steps.name: 'Feranmut'
steps.text: Don't mind me, little one. I might not be able to move my body, but that doesn't mean I can't budge a bit.

steps.name: 'Feranmut'
steps.text: Since you took so much effort to come all this way, I have one more question for you.

steps.name: 'Feranmut'
steps.text: If I am the Feranmut, if I am the light you were seeking...

steps.name: 'Feranmut'
steps.text: Considering how far you've had to come to get here, what exactly were you hoping I would help you with?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Hiya there, mind if I ask if... you've seen Ray around?

steps.name: Enthusiastic Logistics Operator
steps.text: Ray? Saw her just a minute ago!

steps.name: Enthusiastic Logistics Operator
steps.text: As soon as I gave her her food, she walked off while munching out of her lunchbox...

steps.name: Enthusiastic Logistics Operator
steps.text: It looked like she was chasing after a hairy little shadow. Must've been her sandbeast?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Thanks! Sorry for troubling ya!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Mind if I... *huff*... phew... Mind if I ask if you've seen Ray?

steps.name: Doubting HR Operator
steps.text: I've actually seen her a bunch of times today... I was just baffled.

steps.name: Doubting HR Operator
steps.text: While I was in the office this morning, I saw her turn that corner lots of times, and she seemed to be walking faster every time she did it.

steps.name: Doubting HR Operator
steps.text: Now that I think about it, I've seen you a lot today as well, Alanna...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Be... Because I'm looking for her!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Hah... Hah... Hoo...

steps.name: Worried Medic Operator
steps.text: A-Are you alright, Alanna?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I... I'm fine...
Hey.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Whoa—?!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: What's up? Everyone on the ship's been telling me you were looking for me, so I came over.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Is that so... Been spending the whole morning looking for ya, nearly turned the entire ship over while I was at it!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: ...Sorry. I was taking Rory out for walkies.

steps.name: Little Sandbeast
steps.text: (Feeble bellyflop)

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Is it just me... or is your sandbeast a little plumper than before?

steps.name: Big Sandbeast?
steps.text: Wraw?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I've been busy with work lately, so I asked some friends at Logistics to feed it for a few days.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: By the time I got back, Rory had become a ball.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Umm...

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: So that's why I'm taking it on walkies when I'm free.
Ray suddenly seems to remember something, rifling through her jacket pocket.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: This month's installment... Not enough.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Here's my meal card. Take it. Call it... interest.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: You seriously still on about that? I'm not here to get my money back... I just hadn't seen posts about your 'adventures' on the local forum in a while, so I wanted to see how you were doing.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Mmm. Haven't been any safety violations lately, so haven't had to sign any guarantee letters.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: That's great.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: (Long sigh of relief)

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: If I had known it wasn't about the money, I wouldn't have hid from you.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Didn't you just say you were taking the sandbeast out for walkies—?!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I couldn't think of a good excuse.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: You—?!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: You—this—

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: dorm—it's—

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: completely—packed!

steps.name: Big Sandbeast
steps.text: Wraw—!
There is only barely enough space for the two and the beast to pass between the sandbox and the door, and finally they find a little more leeway by the bed.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: When did this sandbox become so big... Must get in the way whenever you're hopping in and out of the room.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Rory needs more space, while I just need somewhere to sleep.
The two of them sit side-by-side on the bed, watching the sandbeast gulp down big mouthfuls of water in the sandbox.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I remember how it always used to hide behind that rock there... Never thought I'd see the day it wouldn't be scared of me.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: The people here aren't scary. The last time Rory smashed up a target, Instructor Dobermann didn't get mad. We ended up fixing it up together.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: That's great. Glad to see your life slowly get back on track.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Y'know, nowadays I spend all my time in Engineering helping debug new equipment. I might be busy as a bee, but it's a thousand times better than life in the mines.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: No more worries about cave-ins or how muddy the drinking water is. Three hot meals a day and a nice, clean bed to sleep in.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Not even my wildest dreams back in the mines had peaceful days like this.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Mmm. Rhodes Island is nice and calm. Got everything you can think of.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: To be honest, I was worried if you were suited to life aboard at first.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: But when I was out there looking for you earlier, I noticed everyone got to know you already. Hell, you're even chums now. I'm not worried anymore.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: So that's why I wanna say, you can stop worrying about paying me back too. You've got a steady life now, so give some thought to the future.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Once you've gotten your sandbeast a nice den, get yourself a little something too. Don't need to keep being a cheapo, y'know...
As Alanna looks around Ray's room, she notices a poster stuck to the ceiling.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Is that... the Frontier?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: An old poster from Columbia. Got it from a roadside hawker during my last mission.
The poster depicts a patch of overgrown land. Above that land, the night sky, strewn with countless twinkling stars.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I also borrowed some documentaries about the place. They talked about how different the wilds of Columbia are from Rim Billiton's, about how there's weird patterns carved into the ground, and bits of iron of all shapes and sizes flying through the sky.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: If that sort of stuff exists, dancing burdenbeasts don't sound too crazy.
Ray stretches out a finger, pointing at the moon on the poster. Her finger follows along the path of its light, all the way to some place even higher in the sky.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Once I've paid you everything back, I'll start saving up.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Once I've got enough, I'll hire a car, and head out into the Columbian wilds to find those burdenbeasts.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: ...Still thinking about those dancing burdenbeasts, huh?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Mmm. And that ray of light.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: But why?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: If you want to go look for a herd of beasts that might not even exist, you'll be giving up the peaceful life you got now.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: ...I dunno.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: But ever since I saw that light, I haven't been able to forget it. Like how a sandbeast in the desert's always searching for water.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: But this ain't a desert. Sandbeasts here can get water whenever they want.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: There's no bottomless mines here. Even the dingiest closet here's brighter than the pit.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Don't tell me you don't like the place, Ray?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: It's not that... I really like it here. It's way better than anywhere I've stayed before.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Right, and your sandbeast likes it here too—

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Hey, wait, where's it gone? It was here just a moment ago...

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: It must've headed out after drinkies were done...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: But I just closed the door...
The sandbox's entrance faces the window. A half-open window.

steps.name: Anxious Operator
steps.text: Have any of you seen Ray's sandbeast?!

steps.name: Flustered Operator
steps.text: Nope, doesn't it normally follow her around everywhere...? W-Wait, did it wander off or something?

steps.name: Enthusiastic Operator
steps.text: Let's go help her find it!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: The security cams have dead zones, so can't say for sure if it's still aboard...

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I'll go borrow a car to chase after it!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: No good! Rhodes Island's already miles away from where it was when the thing scarpered!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: No, I need to find it...

steps.name: Voice from the Communicator
steps.text: Alanna! Alanna! Some operators reported something hanging off the bridge running across the deck.

steps.name: Voice from the Communicator
steps.text: I see you're close to the site, could you help check it out and do some repairs?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: The bridge across the deck...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: A-Alright, got it!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Hoo... Hah...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: You... Y-You get over here!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Huff... Hah... I'm beat...

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: My God, didn't think it'd be able to run all the way up here, especially now that it's a furry little doughball...

steps.name: Big Sandbeast
steps.text: (Scared cry) Wraw...!
The sandbeast throws itself into Ray's arms, rubbing its fur up and down against her hands.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I'm done with this fella. Of all the places in this huge ship, no idea why it decided to climb up to the high ones.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Also I'm the one who saved the little bugger, so why's it nuzzling up to you?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: *sigh* I'm gonna go make my report.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Don't rub up against me, Rory. You gotta get punished if you do something bad.
Ray grabs the sandbeast's two claws, lifting them up over its head.

steps.name: Big Sandbeast
steps.text: (Protesting cry) Wraw!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: C'mon, speak up, why'd you scarper off to somewhere so dangerous?

steps.name: Big Sandbeast
steps.text: (Excited cry) Wraw—

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Whoa, where'd that thunder come from all of a sudden?!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: What is it, Ray?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: ...There's a reason why Rory suddenly climbed up somewhere high.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Oh yeah?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Sandbeasts in the desert are dune-climbers. Sometimes, they'd stand somewhere high up to look out for predators and feel where the wind's blowing.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: When the weather's taking a turn for the worse, sandbeasts will be the first to know, which is why Rory came over here.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Even though Rhodes Island has roofs and no predators, it's still going to do what it normally does.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: But I heard that with real good care, sandbeasts can actually live indoors long-term without having to go back to the desert...

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: You can raise one like that, but it's always gonna be thinking of heading back, to feel the winds of the wilds.

steps.name: Big Sandbeast
steps.text: (Spirited cry) Wraw!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I know... You still think about your days out in the barrens, don't you, Ray?

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: ...You get me?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Of course I don't! I don't know a thing about whatever that ray of light means to you, or that herd of burdenbeasts you're always talking about.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: ...But I know a heart like yours is the type to sorely miss things.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: It's like how I love my life in Engineering, but I still have times I look back at all the beautiful sights I saw while trucking.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Since you're thinking of going, go already.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: ...Thanks, Lanns.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Doesn't matter if you did it for Rory or for me, thanks.

steps.name: Big Sandbeast
steps.text: (Happy cry) Wraw!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I've got one more question, Ray—
Raindrops the size of beans start falling from the sky. The desert welcomes in the year's first sunshower.
Several months later

steps.name: Meticulous Operator
steps.text: Operator Ray. This mission will be in a comparatively remote region of Columbia, with very few supply points.

steps.name: Meticulous Operator
steps.text: In addition, there have been recent reports of Originium energy fluctuations of unknown origin in the area. There will be a certain amount of risk involved.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Sure. I know my way around deserts, and my sandbeast is sensitive to airflows and the temperature. It'll help out.

steps.name: Meticulous Operator
steps.text: I know that you're very capable, and have shown exemplary performance during several prior desert rescue missions.

steps.name: Meticulous Operator
steps.text: But I still have to warn you that this mission is a long one, a month at the very least, and comms might not be particularly steady.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Got it. I'll follow the mission brief. If comms cut out, I'll follow the route and wait at the next supply point.

steps.name: Meticulous Operator
steps.text: That's right. I wish you all the best, Operator Ray.

steps.name: Meticulous Operator
steps.text: Oh, right!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Hmm? Is there something else?

steps.name: Meticulous Operator
steps.text: Thanks for volunteering for this mission. To be honest, it'll be a huge help.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: ...No worries.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Phew, made it just in time. I heard you were heading off on a mission today, so I rushed over to give you some grain feed I bought for your sandbeast.

steps.name: Big Sandbeast
steps.text: (Happy cry) Wraw!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Hey, don't just nuzzle up against anyone who gives you food!
Ray—!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: ...Potlid?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: She heard you were heading somewhere far away, so she insisted on taking some leave to see you off.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: You sure picked a bad time to set off. Right now, the cafeteria's clogged up with people waiting for her to make dinner.

steps.name: Warmy
steps.text: This here's a lunchbox for you, Ray. I heard your later missions are gonna get real tough, so I made sure to pack you extra!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Sure, thanks. I'll make sure to eat it all.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I better get going, then.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Stay safe now, and don't forget to come home.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: I won't. I'll pay you back your money, with interest.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: I already told you, you don't need to pay me back—!

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Pffeh...
Under the setting sun, Alanna and Warmy stand by the deck railing, watching Ray's car drive off into the distance.

steps.name: Warmy
steps.text: Ray went to go find that light and those burdenbeasts, didn't she, Lanns?

steps.name: Warmy
steps.text: When we had just arrived at Rhodes Island, she'd always tell me those stories. I thought she made them up just to make me happy.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Of course she believes in them too. She's not the kind of girl to tell fibs.

steps.name: Warmy
steps.text: I'm really excited to hear all the new stories she'll have.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: Same here. Let's wait for her and give them a listen when she's back.

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: (Loudly) I still got one more question—

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: (Loudly) You ever thought there's a chance you already found that ray of light?

steps.name: Alanna
steps.text: (Loudly) Maybe you already saw that light a second time in your life, but your memory's all fogged up, so you never realized!

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: (Even louder) Well, the chase itself is pretty fun too!
Ray's mind wanders for a moment.
She turns her head to look back at the slowly-shrinking landship, a memory from what seems to be many years ago welling up.
On the day that she was rescued, there was a shadow as huge as a mountain, shooting rays of light through the fog.
And now, on top of that colossal ship, amidst layer upon layer of twilit clouds, stand her friends.
It is the place that she wants to leave, and the place that she will return to.

steps.name: Big Sandbeast
steps.text: (Cry of freedom) Wraw!
The sandbeast's cry pulls Ray back to reality. She returns her gaze to the road ahead.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: No need to rush, Rory. Heading there, looking about, just do it all slow and steady.

steps.name: Ray
steps.text: Doesn't matter if we don't find anything, as long as we keep up the search.
Ray drives past the dunes, speeding towards the depths of the barrens.
The setting sun behind her slowly falls, while the moons in front of her slowly rise. As she watches the moonlight, a lot of things come to mind.
She thinks of the herd of burdenbeasts that welcome the moonlight with dance. She thinks of Rory, looking out into the distance from on high.
She thinks of herself, always searching, always chasing.
